draft.content: To dream of killing a duck is considered an unfavorable sign. According to traditional interpretations, this dream serves as a warning, symbolizing sudden death or an unexpected, severe loss. This imagery may also indicate the abrupt and unforeseen end of an important phase in life.
draft.description: What does it mean to kill a duck in a dream? According to traditional dream dictionaries, this symbol serves as a warning of sudden loss or an abrupt ending.
draft.title: Killing a Duck Dream Meaning
